units.translation: On ⟦1⟧ cf. ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧. The synonymous expressions ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧, ⟦7⟧ are all combined in this sentence. Then again ⟦8⟧: ⟦9⟧ (⟦10⟧), where, if ⟦11⟧, the final short syllable is striking in bacchiacs (or syncopated iambs); therefore Müller ⟦12⟧, to connect with ⟦13⟧ and ⟦14⟧, after which ⟦15⟧ comes to ⟦16⟧. But this is unbearably weak: rather ⟦17⟧ as (Wecklein) ⟦18⟧ ⟦19⟧ ⟦20⟧⟦21⟧, and ⟦22⟧ as the scholiast, with a threatening double meaning: suffered by the citizens, and hard for the citizens to bear. The connection with the previous sentence required because of ⟦23⟧ (cf. above), and the necessary long final syllable of the last bacchius we gain by inserting ⟦24⟧ after ⟦25⟧ (⟦26⟧).
to cast stains upon the land
I groan; what shall I do? What will become of me?
hard to bear for the citizens I suffered
the earth defiled by the pollutions of blood
⟦1⟧ Hermann supports with ⟦2⟧ (same rhythms) ⟦3⟧; ⟦4⟧; (⟦5⟧.); ⟦6⟧ (as an exclamation ⟦7⟧) stands ⟦8⟧, and is like ⟦9⟧; ⟦10⟧; Homer & 465.
What shall I do? What will become of me?
what then will happen to me at the last?
⟦1⟧ probably not interrogative, but like ⟦2⟧ 840. The wild fury finds its true expression at this point. –
⟦1⟧ see on ⟦2⟧ 387. Fittingly they close with an exclamation about their misfortune and the dishonoring of the old gods (⟦3⟧ 780, ⟦4⟧ 793). was.

The speech has 14 verses, the next (824 ff.) 13; one has wanted to equalize them one way or another, while yet afterwards in the speeches after Str. Ant. ⟦1⟧ the greatest inequality prevails, and only by strong deletion in the one and by assuming a lacuna in the other (Wecklein) does the symmetry emerge.
On ⟦1⟧ (legal decision as at 732) ⟦2⟧ cf. ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, 1011 ⟦6⟧, 1084 (also we similarly 'come out').
if they should come out rightly
may Phoebus not come out clear to me

⟦1⟧ in accordance with the truth, since the matter was really doubtful. To ⟦2⟧ the clause with ⟦3⟧ attaches itself, which at the same time gives a reason, therefore ⟦4⟧ . . ⟦5⟧ (⟦6⟧, ⟦7⟧, yet with a different use of the ⟦8⟧). The testimonies of Zeus consist in Apollo's assurance that he has spoken here as elsewhere on his father's commission, 616 ff. (⟦9⟧ -10—/ ‿ ‿, like ⟦10⟧ 107).
